field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable NetBird.

field.label: WireGuard Port
field.help: UDP port for the WireGuard interface (use 0 for automatic port selection).

field.label: MTU
field.help: MTU for the WireGuard interface (default 1280, range 576-8192).

field.label: Force IP Mapping
field.help: Advertise static public IPv4 addresses to peers instead of automatic STUN discovery (public-IP, public-IP/local-IP, or public-IP/interface, e.g. 203.0.113.10/em0).

field.label: Interface Blacklist
field.help: Interfaces NetBird should ignore when discovering peer connection paths (for example, internal VLANs or backup WANs).

field.label: Network Monitor
field.help: Monitor network changes and reconnect automatically when interfaces or routes change.

field.label: Disable Auto-Connect
field.help: Do not connect automatically when the NetBird service starts.

field.label: Force Relay
field.help: Force all peer connections through relay servers instead of direct P2P.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Set the syslog logging level.

field.label: Traffic Handling
field.help: NetBird mode enforces NetBird's access policies and routed networks automatically. OPNsense mode hands traffic to OPNsense so you control firewall rules, NAT, and routing yourself (assign the NetBird interface under Interfaces -> Assignments).

field.label: Accept Server Routes
field.help: Allow this firewall to act as a routing peer or exit node for routes assigned by the NetBird management server.

field.label: Access LAN
field.help: Allow remote NetBird peers to reach OPNsense's local subnets when this firewall acts as a routing peer or exit node.

field.label: Block Inbound Connections
field.help: Block incoming connections initiated by remote NetBird peers (also prevents this firewall from acting as a routing peer).

field.label: Accept Client Routes
field.help: Install routes advertised by other NetBird peers into OPNsense's routing table. Warning: if another peer advertises an exit node (0.0.0.0/0), it can override OPNsense's default gateway.

field.label: Enable Host DNS Management
field.help: Allow NetBird to modify resolv.conf on this firewall (conflicts with OPNsense DNS management). Tip: leave this off and configure Services -> Unbound DNS -> Query Forwarding for your NetBird domain pointing to the second-to-last IP of your NetBird subnet (e.g. 100.64.255.254) when using NetBird mode.

field.label: Enable
field.help: Allow incoming NetBird SSH connections. Warning: bypasses and blocks standard OPNsense SSH for NetBird peers.

field.label: Enable Root Login
field.help: Allow root login over NetBird SSH.

field.label: Enable SFTP
field.help: Enable SFTP file transfers over NetBird SSH.

field.label: Enable Local Port Forwarding
field.help: Allow local port forwarding over NetBird SSH. Warning: forwarded connections originate from the firewall itself and may bypass pf rules.

field.label: Enable Remote Port Forwarding
field.help: Allow remote port forwarding over NetBird SSH. Warning: forwarded connections originate from the firewall itself and may bypass pf rules.

field.label: Enable Rosenpass
field.help: Deprecated by NetBird and not recommended for new setups.

field.label: Rosenpass Permissive Mode
field.help: Accept standard WireGuard connections from peers without Rosenpass enabled (deprecated by NetBird).
